title: One Selector, Many Domains: research release (code, sealed runs and analysis)
description:
The research release for the paper One Selector, Many Domains (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24555154): one shared decision selector choosing among candidate actions written for each domain, tested against each domain's standard method and against plain rollout on real tools, real data and real models.

It contains the selector and domain hosts, every pre-registration and seal (files fingerprinted and pushed before each run), the result files of REAL1, REAL3, STRUCT1, CONF1-CONF6 and ABL1, the analysis scripts, one-command reproduction scripts, the three papers (PDF and source) and the protocol SRC-X.5. Third-party data is fetched at run time by the included scripts and checked against its fingerprint; it is not redistributed.

Website: https://r-a-elu-architecture.github.io/rsos-one-seed/
